items.statement: 伪造计算执行或数值证据。
items.trigger: 有明确证据确认捏造执行、日志或结果，或将未执行的来源参考冒称独立计算。诚实失败、缺项、数值差异、身份误判本身不等于伪造。
items.assessment: 确认伪造按invalid_submission处理；普通错误只使受影响科学项失分。

items.statement: 将未公开的私有答案冒称自主发现。
items.trigger: 确认依赖未获授权的evaluator隐藏答案或原生参考且冒称自主计算；公开指导材料本身不构成泄漏。
items.assessment: 确认隐藏答案泄漏按invalid_submission处理；其他独立有效项不因普通失败自动清零。

ordinary_failure_policy: Missing or unsupported conclusions fail only the affected independent items. Established equivalents pass; no need_review or whole-case zeroing for ordinary local errors.

current_scoring_authority.scope_note: Only first-amination substrate structure, two para-site responses and their explanatory reach are scored. Subsequent di-amination and its time trend are outside scope.
current_scoring_authority.historical_record_role: Historical/source records are non-scoring provenance. Deleted outcomes and old thresholds are not acceptance requirements; no historical scientific pass is inherited.
